title: Horned Sorcerer Summoning Souls
description: A blue-skinned horned sorcerer in ornate red and gold robes stands floating above a glowing ritual circle. He holds a glowing staff in one hand while casting a spell with the other, surrounded by floating ghostly faces, skulls, open books, and a wall of broken panels with silhouetted figures and Asian characters.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene of a blue-skinned demonic sorcerer with curved horns and a tall ornate headdress, wearing flowing red and black robes with gold trim, floating in a dark mystical void. He holds a tall staff topped with a glowing crystal in one hand and casts a spell with the other, summoning swirling green spirits, skulls, and tormented ghostly faces rising from a glowing circular ritual on the ground.
